verdict.rationale: Auto-enrichment is a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence pack never documents enrichment of contact or company records with firmographic or contact data. The nearby evidence covers other features: automatic deduplication by email and domain, AI-approved CRM updates after meetings, imports, and a community remark about improving CRM data quality. None of these is the enrichment capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
